overview_description.description: BoomLand is a blockchain gaming platform that gives a revolutionary gaming experience. It aims to create a sustainable ecosystem where global players are free to play, earn and live by unlocking the value of their in-game assets and Metaverse tokens. BoomLand was founded n 2021.
